results.question: Using only the source card, answer this in plain language: What do the water numbers mean?
results.context: Source: src/data/guide.ts, topic water. Crop ET describes estimated evapotranspiration. Effective rainfall is the part of rain used by the screening model. Net irrigation also accounts for the stated root-zone storage assumptions. Delivered irrigation divides net irrigation by application efficiency. One millimetre over one hectare is 10 cubic metres. These are screening estimates, not metered water use.
results.reference: Crop ET describes estimated evapotranspiration. Effective rainfall is the part of rain used by the screening model. These are screening estimates, not metered water use.

results.question: Using only the source card, answer this in plain language: Why is paddy rice limited in the rotation engine?
